messages:
Maya R.: Hi all 44b Im Maya, joining product analytics this morning. Laptop arrived but Im stuck on the MDM screen 62c it says "Awaiting admin approval". Who handles that?

Jon P.: welcome Maya! :tada: Im Jon from IT, I3b2 I3b2. Can you confirm if the device is enrolled under your personal email or the company email? Also drop the serial if you can.

Maya R.: serial LPLZ12345678, enrolled with my company email (maya@redwood). I clicked approve in Okta but the MDM status is still pending.

IT Bot: Device LPLZ12345678 detected. Status: pending_admin_approval. Auto-approve window: 15m. If not approved, ticket IT-2319 will be created.

Jon P.: thanks. Im going to manually approve now. If enroll still fails, wel push a recovery profile.

Sasha M.: hi Maya! Im your onboarding buddy this week. If you want, we can do a 20m screenshare after lunch to walk through getting access to BigQuery and the dashboard repo. Also obligatory fun-fact: Im learning to salsa dance and have two rescue parrots.

Maya R.: yay, parrots! screenshare works. Also small question: who do I ping for Google Group access to product-analytics?

Jon P.: ping @Ibrahim and I4e2 hel add you. Ibrahim, can you add maya@redwood to product-analytics?

Ibrahim K.: added. You should see the group in ~5 minutes. Also granted view access to the analytics dataset.

Maya R.: got it, I see the group. Thanks! Quick one more: VPN client shows "certificate missing" when I try to connect to corp.vpn.redwood.com.

Jon P.: thats the MDM profile issue. I pushed a recovery profile and reissued a client cert. Try reconnecting and paste any error if it persists.

Maya R.: reconnect worked :relieved: VPN connected. Thanks everyone. Going to join the 1pm intro with product.

People Ops: Welcome officially, Maya! Hoodie size? S/M/L/XL. Also were sending a welcome kit 381 pick between the coffee set or a desk plant.

Maya R.: hoodie L and plant please 331. Thanks for the warm welcome, excited to be here!

Jon P.: great, all set. Sasha and Maya 91d demo at 3pm?

Sasha M.: yep, see you then.

Maya R.: see you! :smile:
